question: Which of the following is NOT typically considered a determinant that shapes a health plan at the district level in India?

answers.text: Epidemiological profile of the district (disease burden and priorities)

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: This is a core determinant — situation analysis of the epidemiological profile is the starting point of health planning.
Resource availability directly shapes what a health plan can realistically achieve — it is a fundamental determinant.

answers.text: The personal religious beliefs of the district collector

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. While political will and governance matter, the personal religious beliefs of individual administrators are not a recognised determinant in the health planning framework. Determinants include epidemiological data, resources, political will, legislation, and community values — not individual religious preferences.
National policies (NHM, NHP 2017) set the framework within which district plans operate — they are a key determinant.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the determinants of health planning: epidemiological profile, resource availability, political will, legislation, and national policy guidelines are the recognised shaping forces.
Well done. Health planning determinants are systematic — epidemiological, resource-based, policy-driven, and community-grounded. Individual personal beliefs are not part of this framework.
